name: Street Soccer 2
summary:
Doltish soccer players come back. New version of Street Soccer offers more matches, more goals, more pain! It doesn't matter if you play in a clean or dirty way, you must become the street king. Win making more goals or destroying your opponents. Do you like to get red cards? No problems, you can take advantage of your experience.

This is a street soccer simulator. Hooligan teams are playing. The soccer match is combined with battles and bloody fights. You are going to experience battles against 9 different teams on 3 different fields. The game offers such extra options as Medical kit, Speed Boost, Amazing Fireball.
